notes.title: Draft version released
notes.notes: The draft version of this game has been released for free. Interested players can download it from the store page for a trial.

notes.title: Game Release Time
notes.notes: This game may not be released in 2024, and the specific release time will be announced later.

notes.title: The Release will be postponed
notes.notes: Due to financial problems, the release will be postponed to 2023 or 2024.

notes.title: "Heart of a Bird in a Cage" will be postponed to release in 2022
notes.notes: "Heart of a Bird in a Cage" just had an alpha test, the test result is very unsatisfactory. The reason is that the CGs are all illustrated separately, when they form a story together the stage effect is very poor, so more than half of the CGs may have to be redrawn, and we are also considering finding a director. Although "Heart of a Bird in a Cage" is free, the game is still made in earnest. Sorry for this bad news.
